title: ChunkedWriteHandler sometimes fails to fulfill a promise correctly
body:
Report from Cédric Chéneau:

Using netty 4.0.15 as Http server to stream video content on UPnp device, I get the following warning:

```
[WARN ] - 21:26:51.399 [nioEventLoopGroup-3-2] [io.netty.handler.stream.ChunkedWriteHandler:151] - ChunkedInput.isEndOfInput() failed
java.lang.IllegalStateException: complete already: DefaultChannelPromise@36501c9b(failure(java.nio.channels.ClosedChannelException)
    at io.netty.util.concurrent.DefaultPromise.setSuccess(DefaultPromise.java:393) ~[netty-common-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelPromise.setSuccess(DefaultChannelPromise.java:76) ~[netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelPromise.setSuccess(DefaultChannelPromise.java:71) ~[netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.handler.stream.ChunkedWriteHandler$PendingWrite.success(ChunkedWriteHandler.java:352) ~[netty-handler-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.handler.stream.ChunkedWriteHandler.discard(ChunkedWriteHandler.java:183) [netty-handler-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.handler.stream.ChunkedWriteHandler.doFlush(ChunkedWriteHandler.java:203) [netty-handler-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.handler.stream.ChunkedWriteHandler.channelInactive(ChunkedWriteHandler.java:147) [netty-handler-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.invokeChannelInactive(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:238) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.fireChannelInactive(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:224) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter.channelInactive(ChannelInboundHandlerAdapter.java:75) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.handler.codec.http.HttpObjectAggregator.channelInactive(HttpObjectAggregator.java:226) [netty-codec-http-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.invokeChannelInactive(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:238) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.fireChannelInactive(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:224) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.handler.codec.ReplayingDecoder.channelInactive(ReplayingDecoder.java:347) [netty-codec-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.invokeChannelInactive(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:238) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelHandlerContext.fireChannelInactive(DefaultChannelHandlerContext.java:224) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.DefaultChannelPipeline.fireChannelInactive(DefaultChannelPipeline.java:767) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.AbstractChannel$AbstractUnsafe$5.run(AbstractChannel.java:560) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.util.concurrent.SingleThreadEventExecutor.runAllTasks(SingleThreadEventExecutor.java:354) [netty-common-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.channel.nio.NioEventLoop.run(NioEventLoop.java:353) [netty-transport-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at io.netty.util.concurrent.SingleThreadEventExecutor$2.run(SingleThreadEventExecutor.java:101) [netty-common-4.0.15.Final.jar:4.0.15.Final]
    at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:722) [na:1.7.0_02]
```

All works fine (streamin is OK), but I just wonder if this warning can be ignored.

Perhaps, something is wrong in my implementation: here is the code: https://github.com/ccheneau/Holmes/tree/master/holmes-core/src/main/java/net/holmes/core/service/http
